CEYLON ELECTRICITY BOARD ACT, No. 17 OF 1969
Order under Section 57

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 57 of the Ceylon Electricity Board Act, No. 17 of 1969, I, RanjithSiyambalapitiya, Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, do by this Order, approve the proposed acquisition of landsrequired by the Ceylon Electricity Board and described in the Schedule hereto.
RANJITH SIYAMBALAPITIYA,Minister of Power and Renewable Energy.
26th April 2017.
SCHEDULE

The land called Punchinadungolla situated in the Village of Weralugampola in Grama Niladari’s Division of 392AWeralugampola in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Dompe, in the Gangaboda Pattu of Siyane Korale, in theAdministrative District of Gampaha, in the Province of Western of Sri Lanka containing in extent of 80 perches shown inthe rough sketch No. CEB/NTDND&EIP/P2/L1/L2 dated 07.03.2017 prepared by Ceylon Electricity Board, for 20ftwide access road bounded as follows :-

North:Land claimed by Saman Weerakkody, K. K. A. Ariyadasa and Padmini Lokubalasuriya ;East:Land claimed by Padmini Lokubalasuriya and Ela ;South:Land claimed by Padmini Lokubalasuriya, A. M. S. Gamini and Mahahena Papiliyawala Road ;West:Land claimed by Padmini Lokubalasuriya, Aruna Ariyawansa and K. K. A. Ariyadasa.
Claimed by:Mrs. Padmini Lokubalasuriya, No. 910/10/J, Adikaram Watta, Ethul Kotte.Mr. Aruna Ariyawansa, No. 254/1, Weralugampola, Pepiliyawala.
